deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
deleteDialog.body: The course, its materials and your progress in it will be deleted. This can’t be undone.

history.title: Aula’s changes
history.body: What Aula changed in this course (when creating it, when you asked for changes, or from the chat). You can undo any of them.
history.empty: Aula hasn’t changed anything in this course yet.
history.alsoUndo_one: {{count}} later Aula change to the same files is undone too.
history.alsoUndo_other: {{count}} later Aula changes to the same files are undone too.
history.conflicts_one: {{count}} part you changed afterwards stays as it is.
history.conflicts_other: {{count}} parts you changed afterwards stay as they are.

changes.title: Ask Aula for changes
changes.body: Tell it what to change or add. The team does it in the background and verifies every exercise.
changes.undoHint: You can undo it from “Aula’s changes”.
changes.placeholder: For example: add double-angle identity exercises, harder than the current ones…
changes.materialsHint: Notes, slides or an exam to take into account.

suggest.simpler: Explain in simpler words, one step slower.
suggest.cards: Add more flashcards with the essentials.

freshReadiness: Your estimated grade appears as soon as you practice your first topic, and sharpens with every exercise.
selfPaced: At your own pace: Aula plans without a deadline.

status.stopped: Creation stopped before any topic was written
status.limit: Creation stopped at a usage limit

title.stopped: The course has no topics yet

reason.auth: The AI that Aula uses isn’t signed in, so it couldn’t start writing. Sign in (Settings → Your AI shows you how) and try again.
reason.network: Aula couldn’t reach the AI: there was no internet connection or the service didn’t answer. Check your connection and try again.
reason.notInstalled: The AI tool Aula uses isn’t installed on this computer. Install it or pick another one in Settings → Your AI.
reason.timeout: The AI took too long to answer and stopped. Trying again usually works.
reason.limit: An AI usage limit was reached before the course was finished. Nothing is lost: try again when it renews.
reason.noMaterial: There was nothing to build the content from: add materials, write the topics or allow web search.
reason.other: Something went wrong while Aula was preparing the course, and no topic got written. You can try again with the same request.
reason.stopped: Creation was paused (you stopped it, or Aula was closed). Nothing is lost: Aula can pick up where it left off.

failure.buildingBody: Topics will show up here as soon as they’re written. You can follow the team’s work in the monitor.

request.title: Trying again uses
request.body: The same request: there is nothing to add again.
request.noMaterials: None: the topic and, if allowed, the web

title.failed: Creation stopped by an error at {{pct}}
title.limit: Creation paused at a usage limit ({{pct}})

partial.body: This course isn’t finished: some topics, the glossary, the formula sheet or the mock exam may be missing.
partial.kept: Done: the course stays as it is

examPastBody: How did it go? A short review now and then keeps what you learned from fading; Aula keeps planning without a deadline.
